title: chylismia exilis
intro: Chylismia exilis, commonly known as Desert Marigold, is a flowering plant native to the southwestern United States and northwestern Mexico. It has been used in traditional medicine for its various health benefits, including anti-inflammatory and antimicrobial properties, which can aid in reducing pain and promoting wound healing. The therapeutic actions of Desert Marigold include its antioxidant and antitumor activities, which can help protect against cell damage and cancer. The bioactive constituents of Desert Marigold include sesquiterpenes, flavonoids, and alkaloids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
